scene.name: 名前を確かめる
scene.purpose: 未知の相手と短く話し、安全を確かめてから扉へ進む

panels.art: At the CLOSED vault door, Yun turns toward Sei Kou, both hands EMPTY, wary. No sword visible.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Sei Kou stops one pace away, keeps both open hands visible, speaks gently. Door remains CLOSED.
panels.speaker: セイ・コウ
panels.text: セイ・コウ。この門の主だ。

panels.art: Close Yun checks the rope marks on his now FREE wrist. He looks back at the exit, then at the master.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: もう、縛らないでください。

panels.art: Sei Kou steps aside to leave an unobstructed retreat. Yun takes a breath before facing the CLOSED door. No sword or vault interior yet.
panels.speaker: セイ・コウ
panels.text: 約束する。ここで待とう。

scene.name: 声へ返事をする
scene.purpose: 宝を取る喜びから人の救助へ、音を聞き分けて自分で選ぶ

panels.art: Yun at the treasury exit pauses, ONE black sword safely SHEATHED at left hip. Treasure remains behind him. He turns toward a muffled sound from the lower passage. No prisoner visible.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Small close-up free left fingers set ONE ingot down on a treasury shelf. No duplicate carried ingots. Calm decision, not tossing valuables.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun kneels outside a CLOSED wooden cellar door, lowers his voice. He does NOT open it yet; no smith or bound hands visible.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 聞こえる？　助けに来た。

panels.art: Yun listens with his palm on the CLOSED door. A faint knock answers; his tense shoulders ease. No prisoner, chains or new person shown yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scene.name: 自分で選ぶ仕事
scene.purpose: 自由になった直後に働かせず、安心と本人の意思を会話で確かめる

panels.art: Quiet forge before repair. So Rin sits on a low stool, looks at her bare FREE wrists. No chains. Yun with SHEATHED black sword stands a respectful step away. Her plain work sleeves unchanged.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin reaches toward a familiar small hammer lying on workbench, then pauses just before touching it. Hands visible, no restraint.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Yun slides a cup of water onto the table; both characters' hands clear, one cup. Warm light, no bargain or payment.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin gently picks up ONE hammer herself, takes a steady breath and meets Yun's eyes. His sword still SHEATHED, no cyan forged edge yet.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

scene.name: 落ちる先を見る
scene.purpose: 挑発から大技へ飛ばず、傷つけない勝ち方を足場と退路から組み立てる

panels.art: BEFORE any arena attack: Yun with ONE sword SHEATHED studies the arena edge and the broad sand landing zone below. Opponents hold position, no one falling.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close Yun's shoe gently tests an existing seam in arena stone. No shockwave, no cracks propagating yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun raises one OPEN hand to warn the spear king and nearby opponents, not casting a spell yet. Opponents alert, safe distance from spectators.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close Yun sees opponents brace knees and loosen grips, then lowers his shoulders with focus. His sword remains SHEATHED. Victory and falling bodies not visible yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scene.name: 敵の夜を聞く
scene.purpose: 敵の痛みを知る夜を実際に描き、強制印を切る決断に重さを作る

panels.art: Night forge: Yun and Hakujin sit opposite each other by a small lamp. Yun sword SHEATHED; Hakujin RIGHT wrist still has intact dark control mark. Neither attacks.
panels.speaker: 白燼
panels.text: 目が覚めても、戦いの中だ。

panels.art: Hakujin looks down at his trembling RIGHT fingers below the intact wrist mark, other hand empty. Yun listens without interruption.
panels.speaker: 白燼
panels.text: 手を、止められなかった。

panels.art: Yun places a cup within Hakujin's reach without forcing it into his marked hand. Yun's expression remorseful, no memory montage.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 俺は、何も知らなかった。

panels.art: Late night fading to predawn at forge window. Two men still seated, lamp low, wrist mark still intact. Yun stays, no drawn weapon, no released mark yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 今は、ちゃんと聞きたい。

scene.name: 記録の重さ
scene.purpose: 記録を見せる前に読み合わせ、ソ・リン自身が公に証言する意思を選ぶ

panels.art: Town square side: So Rin spreads an old metal plate and its corresponding ledger on a low table. Yun with sword SHEATHED reads, Hakujin stands quietly nearby, RIGHT wrist clean.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin points to the repeated maker's stamp engraved on ONE plate, no invented readable background letters. She recognizes her own work.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Yun pauses, looks from plate to So Rin, does not pull her forward. Tense crowd stays behind them; no attack.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin takes the plate into her own hands and chooses to step toward the waiting town mother. Yun supports beside her, no public reveal of marks yet.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

scene.name: 守る場所を決める
scene.purpose: 退避を続けながら一人で防げない範囲を確かめ、仲間に頼る理由を作る

panels.art: Town evacuation continues. Yun with sword SHEATHED looks between two streets where marked living soldiers approach. No protective dome yet. Civilians moving toward safe alley.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 両方には、手が届かない。

panels.art: So Rin signals civilians toward the forge's side alley, checks the last child is beside their parent. Practical, no victims newly invented.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Hakujin with CLEAN right wrist stands at a side junction, OPEN palms stopping people from running into danger, not attacking marked soldiers. Yun sees him.
panels.speaker: 白燼

panels.art: Close Yun opens his tense empty hands, takes a breath and looks toward approaching allies off-frame. His one sword remains SHEATHED, no hologram or shield yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 一人で、抱えなくていい。

scene.name: 条件を疑う
scene.purpose: 人を殺す条件を拒むだけで終わらず、仲間と根拠を探して次の試行へ進む

panels.art: Paused gate with bronze disk still in FRONT slot. Yun keeps ONE black sword SHEATHED and turns from the gate to Hakujin. No chief or red interference yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 帰りたい。でも、斬れない。

panels.art: Hakujin, both hands empty and CLEAN right wrist, slowly lowers his head, visibly exhales. Yun stays beside him.
panels.speaker: 白燼

panels.art: So Rin studies the already found narrow BACK groove by lamp light, fingertip near its old scratches. Front bronze disk remains singular. No sword inserted yet.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Yun kneels beside So Rin to compare the fine groove with the map on the stone floor. Hakujin watches, no solution hologram or blade drawn yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scene.name: 戻った日常を確かめる
scene.purpose: 母への電話の後、部屋で休み、帰還の実感と次に会う意思を育てる

panels.art: MODERN student room after his call: Yun still in ivory martial robe charcoal lapel and dark red sash, ONE sword SHEATHED at left hip. He puts smartphone face DOWN beside a closed textbook. Worn cloth tool bag on floor, no magical portal visible.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun sits at desk, cradles ONE mug with both hands, looks at steam. Same robes and ponytail, subtle LEFT cheek bruise, calm eyes. No extra sword, no modern haircut.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 温かい。ちゃんと、分かる。

panels.art: Large quiet view of Yun asleep in desk chair as DAWN light fills his room. Same robe, sheathed sword safely beside chair, tool bag near feet. No dialogue, no text anywhere.
Morning: rested Yun places a small tea packet and bandages on a white cloth, preparing the SINGLE white bundle used in the next scene. ONE sword sheathed at left hip, no portal yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
